adapter.kingbaseQualification: Official platform integration for the validated combination only: KingbaseES V009R002C016, oracle mode, JDBC database version 12.1, driver V008R006B0001. A real FULL task has 270 terminal result records: 261 contracts invoked and 9 not invoked due to missing or blocked preparation (4 direct, 5 blocked); 252 passed, 9 failed and 9 aborted, with successful cleanup. Official does not mean all JDBC tests passed. Missing SQL fixtures, XA configuration limits and observed JDBC failures remain documented; other builds, modes and drivers are unvalidated.
